invented.quote: For the past three years Tomás has run our 3 a.m. milking shift on his own, five days a week.
invented.why: The brief states that Tomás has worked at the farm for three years and that he currently runs the 3 a.m. shift on his own, not that he has run that shift on his own for the entire three years.

invented.quote: In three years he has missed two shifts.
invented.why: The brief states that he missed two shifts in three years 'not counting those 5 weeks' he left for Mexico, which the document omits.

invented.quote: Tomás also took on more than his job required.
invented.why: The brief states that he learned the herd management software and flags sick cows, but does not state whether this was outside his job requirements.

invented.quote: Nobody asked him to do that.
invented.why: The brief does not state that Tomás learned the software and began flagging sick cows without being asked.
The brief only states that his written English is weaker than his spoken English, not that his spoken English is strong.

invented.quote: On his own initiative he is taking a night class to bring his written English up to the same level. He did not wait for anyone to tell him to.
invented.why: The brief states that he is taking a night class for his written English, but does not say that he enrolled on his own initiative without being told to.
